learning_outcomes.text: Applies business organization techniques in a practical way.
Knows the tools for operations management at both strategic and tactical levels.
Has applied knowledge of economics and production organization. Knows the sources and systems of business financing.
Develops own strategies to solve problems and find solutions. Is capable of integrating paradigms from other disciplines.

Has an overall vision of the different theories or methodologies of a subject. Makes significant contributions or certain innovations. Transfers learning from classroom cases and exercises to real situations in other areas.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Operations Management and SCM
Industry 4.0: Digital twin and AI applications
Capacity Planning, Location and Plant Layout
Inventory Management: Reorder Point, MRP and JIT
Control Charts for Variables and Attributes
teaching_methods: Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom
assessment_rules: In the second call, the final grade will be the maximum between: (A) The grade obtained from continuous assessment (55%) and the grade from the second call official exam (45%); (B) The grade obtained from the second call official exam (100%). Students who do not take the final exam will receive a 'not presented' grade. Fraudulent use of any means in an evaluative activity will result in a failing grade for that activity.
